capabilities: Syncs note content bi-directionally across vaults
Mirrors whole folders through a SYNC.md manifest
Detects external edits and resolves conflicts with backups
Copies sync targets from the file menu
Maps vault names to per-computer folders in settings
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault sync service; it syncs only the individual notes listed in sync_targets, keeping real .md copies in each vault.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13.4+); uses no network; deletions are not propagated; install the same plugin version in every vault.
problem: Filesystem links (symbolic links, junctions, hardlinks) fail with Obsidian Sync, cloud storage and mobile, so the same note cannot live as a real file in several vaults.

relations.evidence: Copies in other vaults are plain file writes, which Obsidian Sync picks up when that vault is open

summary: Frontmatter-driven sync plugin that keeps individual notes identical across multiple Obsidian vaults.
